examples.en: Every evening my grandmother sits down with her sewing.
The sewing has piled up, so I plan to do it all at once on the weekend.

examples.ko: 어머니가 바느질감을 한 보따리 들고 오셨어요.
examples.en: My mother came carrying a big bundle of sewing.
This piece only needs the buttons sewn on and it's done.
She is dozing with her sewing on her lap.

examples.ko: 가방에 바느질감을 넣어 다니면서 틈틈이 해요.
examples.en: I carry my sewing in my bag and work on it whenever I have time.

explain: 바느질할 옷이나 천을 가리켜요. '바느질'은 하는 일이고, '바느질감'은 그 일을 할 물건이에요. 보통 '바느질감을 꺼내다, 바느질감이 쌓이다'처럼 말해요.

phrases.en: Grandmother took the sewing out of the basket.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바느질을 시작하기 전에 가장 자주 하는 동작이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A very common action just before starting to sew.

phrases.en: I spread the sewing out on the table.
phrases.nuance_ko: 천이나 옷을 넓게 펴 놓을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when laying cloth or clothes flat to work on them.

phrases.en: I've been busy, so a lot of sewing has piled up.
phrases.nuance_ko: 아직 못 한 바느질할 물건이 많아진 상태를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means there is a lot of unfinished sewing waiting to be done.

explain_en: It refers to the clothes or fabric you are going to sew. '바느질' is the activity, while '바느질감' is the material for it. You will often hear '바느질감을 꺼내다' or '바느질감이 쌓이다'.

examples.en: I put insect repellent in the wardrobe.

examples.ko: 방충제 냄새가 너무 강해서 창문을 열었어요.
examples.en: The smell of the repellent was so strong that I opened the window.
Before storing winter clothes, I should buy some repellent first.

examples.ko: 방충제는 아이 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 두세요.
examples.en: Keep the repellent out of children's reach.
Does this repellent really work?

examples.ko: 벌레가 생겨서 방충제로 쓸 만한 걸 찾고 있어요.
examples.en: Bugs have appeared, so I'm looking for something to use as a repellent.

explain: 옷장이나 서랍에 넣어 두는 벌레 막이 물건을 말할 때 자주 나와요. 벌레를 죽이는 '살충제'와 달리 방충제는 벌레가 못 오게 막는 쪽이에요. '넣다, 갈다, 냄새' 같은 말과 함께 써요.

phrases.en: It's good to put mothballs in every drawer.
phrases.nuance_ko: 옷장이나 서랍에 두는 가장 기본적인 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The basic usage: placing it in a wardrobe or drawer.

phrases.en: I change the repellent when the season changes.
phrases.nuance_ko: 오래된 것을 새것으로 바꿀 때 '갈다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 갈다 means to replace an old one with a new one.

phrases.nuance_ko: 방충제 특유의 강한 냄새를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the strong smell typical of repellent.

explain_en: It often refers to the bug-proofing items you put in a wardrobe or drawer. Unlike '살충제', which kills bugs, 방충제 is about keeping bugs away. It goes with words like '넣다', '갈다' and '냄새'.

examples.en: I packed a spare set of clothes in my bag.
If you happen to have a spare, please lend me one.

examples.ko: 비가 올까 봐 여벌로 우산을 하나 더 가져왔어요.
examples.en: I brought one more umbrella just in case it rains.
I made one extra copy of the key.

examples.ko: 여행 갈 때 여벌의 양말도 꼭 챙기세요.
examples.en: Be sure to pack extra socks when you travel.

examples.ko: 여벌이 없어서 젖은 옷을 그대로 입었어요.
examples.en: I had no spare, so I kept wearing the wet clothes.

explain: 입을 옷이나 쓸 물건을 갈아입거나 대신 쓰려고 따로 하나 더 마련한 것을 말해요. '여벌 옷', '여벌 신발', '열쇠 여벌'처럼 옷이나 신발, 열쇠 같은 물건과 잘 어울려요.

phrases.example: 비 올 때를 생각해서 여벌 신발도 챙겼어요.
phrases.en: I packed an extra pair of shoes in case of rain.
phrases.nuance_ko: 갈아 신으려고 따로 준비한 신발을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Shoes prepared separately to change into.

phrases.en: I left the spare key with my mother.
phrases.nuance_ko: 열쇠를 잃어버릴 때를 대비해 하나 더 만든 것이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An extra key made in case the first is lost.

phrases.en: Take an extra pair of socks with you.
phrases.nuance_ko: '여벌로'는 예비로 하나 더 준비한다는 뜻의 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: '여벌로' means preparing one more as a backup.

explain_en: It is something extra set aside as a change or replacement, such as clothes or an item. It pairs well with things like clothes, shoes and keys, as in '여벌 옷', '여벌 신발' and '열쇠 여벌'.

examples.en: Mom flipped the meat with tongs.

examples.ko: 게가 큰 집게발로 제 손가락을 꽉 물었어요.
examples.en: The crab pinched my finger hard with its big claw.
I clipped the laundry onto the line with clothespins.
There were no tongs, so I picked up the kimchi by hand.
At the restaurant, I held tongs and grilled meat.

examples.ko: 이 집게는 힘이 세서 잘 안 떨어져요.
examples.en: This clip is strong, so it doesn't fall off easily.

explain: '빨래집게', '머리 집게'처럼 앞에 말을 붙여 쓰는 일이 많아요. 게의 큰 발은 '집게발'이라고 해요. 아주 작은 것을 집는 도구는 '핀셋'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I hung the socks with clothespins.
phrases.nuance_ko: 빨래를 널 때 쓰는 작은 집게예요. 가장 흔한 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A small clip used to hang laundry. The most common usage.
The pinching claw of a crab or lobster.

phrases.en: I picked up the hot sweet potato with tongs.
phrases.nuance_ko: 손으로 잡기 어려운 것을 도구로 잡을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you grip something hard to hold by hand using a tool.

explain_en: It often takes a word in front, as in 빨래집게 and 머리 집게. A crab's big claw is called 집게발. A tool for gripping very small things is called 핀셋.

en: to dewater; to spin-dry; to dry

examples.en: Even if you spin-dry a duvet, a lot of water stays in it.

examples.ko: 세탁기로 탈수하면 몇 분 안 걸려요.
examples.en: If you spin-dry in the machine, it takes only a few minutes.
I spin-dried the hand-washed clothes and hung them up.
It's better to spin-dry sneakers only briefly.
Please close the lid tightly before spinning.
It's spinning now, so please wait a little.

explain: 세탁기로 빨래의 물기를 빼는 것을 말해요. 손으로 물기를 빼는 건 '짜다'라고 해요. 몸에 물이 부족한 상태는 보통 '탈수 증상'이라고 말해요.

phrases.en: I hang up the laundry after spin-drying it.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-ㄴ 뒤에'를 붙여 순서를 말할 때 써요. 빨래 순서를 말할 때 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding -ㄴ 뒤에 states the order; common when describing laundry steps.

phrases.nuance_ko: 옷 관리 안내처럼 하지 말라고 할 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A prohibition, like on a clothing care instruction.

phrases.en: If you spin-dry for a long time, the clothes get wrinkled.
phrases.nuance_ko: '탈수하다' 대신 '탈수를 하다'로 말하면 시간이나 정도를 덧붙이기 쉬워요.
phrases.nuance_en: Using 탈수를 하다 instead of 탈수하다 makes it easy to add how long or how much.
phrases.en_equiv: to spin-dry for a long time

explain_en: It means removing water from laundry with a washing machine. Wringing water out by hand is '짜다'. For the body lacking water, people usually say '탈수 증상' (dehydration symptoms).
